rationale: Venlafaxine to desvenlafaxine: Desvenlafaxine is the active metabolite of venlafaxine. Reasons for switch: more predictable pharmacokinetics (desvenlafaxine has less CYP2D6-dependent metabolism — plasma levels are more uniform across CYP2D6 phenotypes), or drug interaction simplification. Both have equivalent SNRI mechanism and high discontinuation syndrome risk. Dose conversion: venlafaxine 75 mg ≈ desvenlafaxine 50 mg. Smooth pharmacological switch — start desvenlafaxine at equivalent dose and taper venlafaxine over 1–2 weeks. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Start desvenlafaxine 50 mg. Continue venlafaxine XR 75 mg. Pharmacologically almost identical switch. Both at equivalent doses during the overlap period. No serotonin syndrome risk of clinical significance.
Reduce venlafaxine to 37.5 mg XR. Continue desvenlafaxine 50 mg. Monitor for discontinuation symptoms during venlafaxine reduction.
Stop venlafaxine. Continue desvenlafaxine 50 mg. Titrate to 100 mg at 4 weeks if response inadequate (limited additional efficacy but some patients benefit).

doseRatios.equivalencyNote: Venlafaxine 75 mg ≈ desvenlafaxine 50 mg (commonly used conversion). Individual variation exists. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
